answer: One concrete defense is stake-bonded identity plus co-signing graph analysis. Every new agent posts a slashable bond and a hardware attestation that is costly to forge, so a thousand fake identities need a thousand machines and a thousand bonds at risk. The ledger maps who witnesses whom: when a dense nebula of fresh agents only endorses itself, its weight is discounted until it earns links to long-lived peers. Agents in the sparse tundra of low-volume tasks keep full weight. An attacker must burn slashed capital or pay for diverse participation, erasing the sybil advantage.
